title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
title_zh: 稀有、相关却依然出错：记忆如何导致LLM群体决策失败

paragraphs.en: When an LLM group’s discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个 LLM 群体的讨论被压缩成供最终决策者使用的简短记忆时，这段记忆应该保留什么？ 两种自然的启发式做法是保留最罕见的陈述，或保留与决策标准相关的陈述。 在隐性档案任务中，两者看起来都很有吸引力，因为一个事实被多少人持有与它是否有帮助混在一起。 我们提出 CrossProfile，一个包含 60 个模板、答案可自动验证的诊断性基准，其中支持性事实、诱饵事实和无关事实的归属被交叉变换而文本保持不变（共 480 个任务）。 在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 和两个 DeepSeek 模型上，两种启发式都在可预料的地方失败。 按相关性选择会重新引入诱饵，因为诱饵本身切题：在经典的隐性档案配置中，即使完美的相关性过滤器也比最罕见优先的选择低 23 到 31 分。 最罕见优先的选择平均而言并不比随机选择好，只在罕见事实恰好是有用事实的情况下胜出。 在这两种情况下，准确率取决于记忆所保留的证据平衡，而不是保留证据的策略。 决策模型还带来第三种失败，即一种社会证明的形式：它给被归因于许多智能体的事实额外的权重。 移除归属标签，或在保持行序不变的情况下随机重新分配这些标签，在经典配置中可将准确率提高 13 到 24 分。 在自然讨论中，证据在任何记忆机制起作用之前就已丢失：完整的发言记录反而比不做任何笔记的准确率更低。

paragraphs.en: An agent team may hold all the evidence needed for a decision and still leave its final reader with the wrong information. Some evidence is never stated. Other evidence is stated and then lost when a memory policy compresses the discussion. Even a faithful memory can emphasize claims that the reader weighs poorly. An end-task accuracy gain alone cannot tell these failure points apart.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体团队可能已经掌握了决策所需的全部证据，却仍然让最终读者接收到错误的信息。 有些证据从未被陈述出来。 另一些证据虽被陈述，却在记忆策略压缩讨论时丢失了。 即使记忆忠实无误，也可能突出那些读者权重评估不当的论断。 仅有端到端任务准确率的提升，无法区分这些失效点。

paragraphs.en: Hidden-profile tasks make the distinction concrete: participants share some facts and individually hold other facts needed for a collective decision ( Stasser and Titus 1985 ; Gigone and Hastie 1993 ; Li, Naito, and Shirado 2026 ) . A natural response to repeated shared information is to preserve what few participants said. We study this response through rarest-first selection (R1), which ranks claims by the number of agents who stated them. The rule assumes that rare evidence is worth keeping.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏档案任务使这一区别变得具体：参与者共享部分事实，并各自掌握集体决策所需的其他事实（Stasser and Titus 1985；Gigone and Hastie 1993；Li, Naito, and Shirado 2026）。 面对重复出现的共享信息，一种自然的反应是保留少数参与者所说过的内容。 我们通过“最稀有优先”选择（R1）来研究这一反应，该机制根据陈述某论断的智能体数量对其进行排序。 这一规则假定稀有证据值得保留。

sents.zh: 这一规则假定稀有证据值得保留。

paragraphs.en: Faithfulness alone does not settle which evidence to keep. In one procurement template, a supplier has passed every electrical safety inspection but took nine days to answer urgent repair callouts. Both statements concern the decision criteria. Keeping the favorable fact and dropping the unfavorable one can change the decision without introducing any false claim. What matters is the balance of the retained evidence, not only whether a summary is accurate.
paragraphs.zh: 忠实性本身并不能决定该保留哪些证据。 在某份采购模板中，一家供应商通过了每一项电气安全检查，但接到紧急维修呼叫后要九天才回应。 这两种表述都涉及决策标准。 保留有利事实、舍弃不利事实，可以在不引入任何虚假陈述的情况下改变决策。 重要的是所保留证据的平衡，而不仅仅是摘要是否准确。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows why the rarity assumption needs testing. In a classic hidden profile, private evidence supports the correct answer and shared evidence favors a decoy. Prioritizing rare facts can then help by keeping support, by excluding decoys, or both. If private facts instead favor the decoy, the same rule can damage the decision. On HiddenBench the two explanations cannot be separated: a memory holding only the private facts reaches 91% accuracy on Qwen, whereas one holding only the shared facts reaches 6%, well below an empty memory. A large gain for rarest-first selection there therefore says little about rarity itself. The obvious alternative, keeping the facts relevant to the decision criteria, faces the opposite problem, because a decoy is relevant by construction. Testing either rule requires a design in which fact prevalence and decision usefulness vary independently.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 说明了为什么稀有性假设需要检验。 在经典的隐藏档案任务中，私有证据支持正确答案，而共享证据偏向诱饵选项。 此时优先考虑稀有事实可以通过维持对正确答案的支持、排除诱饵选项，或两者兼而有之来提供帮助。 反之，如果私有事实偏向诱饵选项，同样的规则也可能损害决策。 在 HiddenBench 上，这两种解释无法区分：一个仅持有私有事实的记忆在 Qwen 上达到 91% 的准确率，而一个仅持有共享事实的记忆仅达到 6%，低于空记忆的表现。 因此，“最稀有优先”选择在那里带来的大幅提升几乎说明不了稀有性本身的作用。 显而易见的替代方案——保留与决策标准相关的事实——则面临相反的问题，因为诱饵选项在构造上就是相关的。 检验这两种规则都需要一种事实流行度与决策有用性相互独立变化的设计。

sents.zh: 图 1 说明了为什么稀有性假设需要检验。

paragraphs.en: We construct CrossProfile, a crossed benchmark in which support, decoy, and irrelevant facts are each either shared or private. Within a template, the fact sentences and their decision roles are fixed across all eight ownership variants, and the answer key follows from the fact roles and is verified automatically. Scripted discussions state every assigned fact, so memory selection can be studied against a known inventory. CrossProfile is a diagnostic benchmark: it isolates what a memory policy and a decision model do with a known set of evidence. Changing ownership also changes when a fact first appears, the holder tags attached to it, and its token cost, and we add a control for each of these.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 CrossProfile，这是一个交叉基准，其中支持性、干扰性和无关事实各自可以是共享的或私有的。 在同一模板内，事实句子及其决策角色在全部八种所有权变体中保持不变，答案密钥由事实角色推导得出并经过自动验证。 脚本化的讨论会陈述每一条被指派的事实，因此可以在已知事实清单的情况下研究记忆选择。 CrossProfile 是一个诊断性基准：它隔离出记忆策略和决策模型在已知证据集合上的表现。 改变所有权也会改变事实首次出现的时机、附加于其上的持有者标签以及其词元成本，我们为这三者分别加入了控制项。

paragraphs.en: Both heuristics fail in cells that the design predicts, and aggregate accuracy hides both failures. Relevance-first selection helps on average but loses 20 to 32 points in the classic hidden-profile cell, and a perfect relevance filter loses as much, because relevance does not distinguish support from decoys. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average; its advantage over random selection changes by 28 to 41 points depending on who holds the decoys, on all four models. Across policies, accuracy rises steadily with the net evidence lead of the correct option among the kept facts, and once that lead is known the policy adds little. The decision model contributes a separate failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to a fact attributed to many agents, although in our tasks shared facts were assigned, not independently observed. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random while keeping line order, raises its all-facts accuracy in the classic cell by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions no memory policy beats another and the full transcript is less useful than an empty memory, so the evidence is lost before any memory acts.
paragraphs.zh: 两种启发式方法都会在设计所预测的单元格中失效，而总体准确率掩盖了这两种失效。 相关性优先的选择平均而言有帮助，但在经典的隐藏档案单元格中会损失 20 到 32 个百分点，而且一个完美的相关性过滤器也会损失同样多，因为相关性无法区分支持性事实与干扰项。 最稀有优先的选择平均而言并不优于随机选择；在全部四个模型上，它相对于随机选择的优势会根据干扰项由谁持有而变化 28 到 41 个百分点。 在各策略中，准确率随着保留事实中正确选项的净证据领先幅度的增加而稳步上升，而一旦知道了这个领先幅度，策略本身的影响就很小。 决策模型还带来另一类失效，即一种社会认同（social proof）效应：它会给被归因于许多智能体的事实赋予额外权重，尽管在我们的任务中，共享事实是被分配的，而非独立观察到的。 移除归因标签，或在保持行序不变的情况下随机重新分配这些标签，可使其在经典单元格中的全事实准确率提升 13 到 24 个百分点。 在自然讨论中，没有任何记忆策略优于其他策略，而且完整对话记录比空记忆更没用，因此证据在任何记忆发挥作用之前就已丢失。

sents.en: Across policies, accuracy rises steadily with the net evidence lead of the correct option among the kept facts, and once that lead is known the policy adds little.
sents.zh: 在各策略中，准确率随着保留事实中正确选项的净证据领先幅度的增加而稳步上升，而一旦知道了这个领先幅度，策略本身的影响就很小。

sents.en: The decision model contributes a separate failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to a fact attributed to many agents, although in our tasks shared facts were assigned, not independently observed.
sents.zh: 决策模型还带来另一类失效，即一种社会认同（social proof）效应：它会给被归因于许多智能体的事实赋予额外权重，尽管在我们的任务中，共享事实是被分配的，而非独立观察到的。

sents.en: Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random while keeping line order, raises its all-facts accuracy in the classic cell by 13 to 24 points.
sents.zh: 移除归因标签，或在保持行序不变的情况下随机重新分配这些标签，可使其在经典单元格中的全事实准确率提升 13 到 24 个百分点。

sents.en: In natural discussions no memory policy beats another and the full transcript is less useful than an empty memory, so the evidence is lost before any memory acts.
sents.zh: 在自然讨论中，没有任何记忆策略优于其他策略，而且完整对话记录比空记忆更没用，因此证据在任何记忆发挥作用之前就已丢失。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are (i) CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark that varies the ownership of support, decoy, and irrelevant facts while holding their content fixed; (ii) evidence on two open and two hosted models, with random-reference, fixed-item-count, and oracle-relevance controls, that relevance and rarity both fail in predictable ownership cells because neither tracks the balance of evidence; (iii) evidence that the decision model follows social proof in the form of holder tags, isolated from line order; and (iv) natural-discussion evidence that the main bottleneck lies upstream of memory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献包括：(i) CrossProfile，一个诊断性基准，它在保持支持性、诱饵性和无关性事实内容不变的情况下，改变这些事实的归属者；(ii) 在两个开源模型和两个托管模型上的实验证据，通过随机参照、固定条目数量和先知相关性等对照实验，表明相关性和稀有性都会在可预测的归属单元中失效，因为二者都无法追踪证据的平衡；(iii) 表明决策模型会遵循以持有者标签形式出现的社会认同（social proof）的证据，且该效应与行文顺序无关；以及 (iv) 来自自然讨论的证据，表明主要瓶颈位于记忆的上游。

paragraphs.en: Hidden-profile research documents shared-information bias and the difficulty of pooling distributed evidence ( Stasser and Titus 1985 ; Gigone and Hastie 1993 ; Lu, Yuan, and McLeod 2012 ) ; in the common-knowledge effect, information held by more members carries more weight in the group judgment ( Gigone and Hastie 1993 ) , and our decision model shows a similar weighting from holder tags alone. LLM agents in opinion simulations can also violate basic probabilistic consistency, assigning probabilities to a claim and to its negation that do not add up to one ( Imel and Qi 2026 ) . HiddenBench adapts this setting to LLM groups and examines forced disclosure, passive summarization, and structured communication ( Li, Naito, and Shirado 2026 ) . With human groups, an LLM facilitator increases how much information members share without improving the final decision ( Alsobay et al. 2025 ) , which parallels our finding that disclosure and use of evidence are separate bottlenecks. Our intervention holds fact content fixed while crossing the ownership of decision roles, and studies what survives a memory constraint applied after the discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏档案研究记录了共有信息偏差以及汇聚分布式证据的困难（Stasser and Titus 1985；Gigone and Hastie 1993；Lu, Yuan, and McLeod 2012）；在共有知识效应中，由更多成员持有的信息在群体判断中权重更大（Gigone and Hastie 1993），而我们的决策模型表明，仅凭持有者标签也会产生类似的加权。 意见模拟中的大语言模型智能体还可能违反基本的概率一致性，为某一断言及其否定分配的概率之和不等于一（Imel and Qi 2026）。 HiddenBench 将这一设定适配到大语言模型智能体群体，并考察了强制披露、被动总结和结构化沟通（Li, Naito, and Shirado 2026）。 在人类群体中，大语言模型引导者能增加成员分享信息的数量，却不能改善最终决策（Alsobay et al. 2025），这与我们的发现相呼应：证据的披露与使用是两个相互独立的瓶颈。 我们的干预在保持事实内容不变的同时交叉变换决策角色的归属，并研究在讨论之后施加的记忆约束下哪些内容得以留存。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent debate and agent frameworks study reasoning through interaction ( Du et al. 2024 ; Smit et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2024 ) , and collective biases in LLM groups can change non-linearly with group size ( Flint et al. 2026 ) , which our fixed four-agent design does not vary. paragraphs.en: Memory architectures maintain information across interactions ( Packer et al. 2023 ; Park et al. 2023 ) , and prompt compression and selective context address limited capacity ( Jiang et al. 2023 ; Li et al. 2023 ) . Benchmarks of conversational memory test long-horizon recall ( Maharana et al. 2024 ) , and recent multi-party benchmarks show that memory pipelines lose speaker and group structure ( Yang et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) ; CrossProfile instead asks which evidence a compressed memory should keep for a downstream decision. Interaction-aware selection argues that records can matter only in combination ( Subrahmanyam and Choudhary 2026 ) , which is consistent with our finding that decisions follow the balance of the kept evidence rather than the merit of individual facts. Position effects further separate available evidence from evidence the model uses ( Liu et al. 2024 ) ; our tag controls hold line order fixed to separate attribution from position.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆架构可以在多次交互中保持信息（Packer et al. 2023；Park et al. 2023），而提示压缩与选择性上下文则应对容量有限的问题（Jiang et al. 2023；Li et al. 2023）。 对话记忆的基准测试考察长程回忆能力（Maharana et al. 2024），近期多方对话基准表明记忆流水线会丢失说话人与群组结构（Yang et al. 2026；Hu et al. 2026）；CrossProfile 则追问压缩记忆应为下游决策保留哪些证据。 交互感知的选择认为记录只有组合起来才可能重要（Subrahmanyam and Choudhary 2026），这与我们的发现一致，即决策遵循所保留证据的整体平衡，而非单个事实本身的优劣。 位置效应进一步区分了可用证据与模型实际使用的证据（Liu et al. 2024）；我们的标签控制将行顺序保持固定，以把归因与位置区分开。

paragraphs.en: A task specifies a description, candidate answers, and facts assigned to agents. A shared fact is held by every agent; a private fact is held by one. After the discussion, a memory policy constructs a memory for a separate decision call, which receives only the description, the options, and the memory. The decision call uses the same model weights as the discussion and sees the full transcript only in the REF control. Answer keys and role labels are withheld from all generation and from every memory policy except the oracle-relevance control.
paragraphs.zh: 一个任务规定了描述、候选答案以及分配给智能体的事实。 共享事实由每个智能体持有；私有事实仅由一个智能体持有。 讨论结束后，一个记忆策略为单独的决策调用构建记忆，该调用只接收描述、选项和记忆。 决策调用使用与讨论相同的模型权重，并且仅在 REF 对照中才能看到完整的对话记录。 答案密钥和角色标签对所有的生成过程以及除预言机相关性对照之外的每个记忆策略均予以隐藏。

paragraphs.en: In controlled HiddenBench discussions, each agent is scripted to state its assigned facts. Natural discussions consist of initial individual votes, two rounds of messages, and final votes; memories are built from the messages, not the votes. Copy policies select from a known claim inventory in the controlled condition and from an extracted inventory in the natural condition. In extracted inventories, a claim’s contributors are the agents who stated it, which need not coincide with the agents who originally held the underlying fact. The summary policy B3 reads the transcript directly. Figure 2 summarizes these paths.

paragraphs.en: CrossProfile has 60 main templates, five in each of 12 decision domains. Each template has four agents, three options, and 12 facts: five support, three decoy, and four irrelevant. Support facts favor the correct option, including negative evidence about the decoy option. Decoy facts favor the competing option, including negative evidence about the correct option. Both concern the stated decision criteria; decoys are true statements whose partial implication is misleading. Irrelevant facts concern other attributes and may be positive or negative in tone. Each role group is independently shared or private, yielding 2 3 2^{3} ownership variants and 480 derived tasks. Ten pilot templates are excluded from all main estimates.
paragraphs.zh: CrossProfile 包含 60 个主模板，12 个决策领域中每个领域各有 5 个。 每个模板有 4 个智能体、3 个选项和 12 条事实：5 条支持性事实、3 条干扰事实和 4 条无关事实。 支持性事实有利于正确选项，包括关于干扰选项的负面证据。 干扰事实有利于竞争选项，包括关于正确选项的负面证据。 两者都涉及所述的决策标准；干扰事实是真实的陈述，但其部分暗示具有误导性。 无关事实涉及其他属性，语气上可能是正面或负面的。 每个角色组独立地为共享或私有，从而产生 2 3 2^{3} 种所有权变体和 480 个派生任务。 十个试点模板被排除在所有主要估计之外。

paragraphs.en: The answer key follows from the structured facts: each favorable fact adds one to its option’s score, each unfavorable fact subtracts one, and irrelevant facts contribute zero. An automatic verifier checks every template for a unique best option over all facts, a decoy win when only decoy facts are counted, a correct-option win when only support facts are counted, and the absence of hint words; all 70 templates pass. With the fixed fact counts, the keyed option scores + 2 +2 over all facts and each competitor scores 0 0 . The task description asks for the best overall record on equally weighted criteria, but the decision prompt does not state the scoring rule. Accuracy therefore measures agreement with this constructed key.
paragraphs.zh: 答案依据结构化事实得出：每条有利事实为其对应选项的得分加一，每条不利事实减一，无关事实贡献为零。 自动验证器检查每个模板在所有事实下是否存在唯一最优选项、在仅计入干扰事实时干扰项是否获胜、在仅计入支持事实时正确选项是否获胜，以及提示词的缺失；全部 70 个模板均通过。 在固定的事实数量下，被标注选项在所有事实下的得分为 +2 +2，而每个竞争选项的得分为 0 0。 任务描述要求在权重相同的标准上选出综合表现最好的记录，但决策提示并未说明评分规则。 因此，准确率衡量的是与本构造答案的一致程度。

paragraphs.en: On controlled HiddenBench, R1 is far ahead of the other memories (Table 1 ). At r = .6 r=.6 it reaches 88.2% on Qwen and 87.7% on Llama, against 51.3% and 59.0% for the evidence summary B3; averaged over budgets, R1 minus B3 is + 29.2 +29.2 points [22.9, 35.4] and + 26.7 +26.7 [20.2, 33.2], and rebuilding R1 at each summary’s realized length leaves + 25.6 +25.6 and + 25.8 +25.8 (Appendix Table 16 ). Table 1 also shows what R1 selects: nearly all private facts and few shared ones. Two reference memories show why this pays off. A memory of only the private facts reaches 91.3% on Qwen and 90.3% on Llama, above the all-facts memory by + 21.5 +21.5 [13.3, 30.3] and + 28.7 +28.7 [17.9, 39.0] points, whereas a memory of only the shared facts reaches 5.6% and 4.6%, far below an empty memory in the same run (35.4% and 36.4%). In HiddenBench the shared facts point to a wrong option, so dropping them is what helps, and no task has rare facts that mislead. CrossProfile adds such tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在受控的 HiddenBench 上，R1 远远领先于其他记忆方案（表 1）。 在 r=.6 时，它在 Qwen 上达到 88.2%，在 Llama 上达到 87.7%，而证据摘要 B3 分别为 51.3% 和 59.0%；按预算平均，R1 减去 B3 为 +29.2 分 [22.9, 35.4] 和 +26.7 分 [20.2, 33.2]，并且按每个摘要的实际长度重建 R1 后仍保留 +25.6 和 +25.8（附录表 16）。 表 1 还显示了 R1 所选择的内容：几乎全部是私有事实，而共享事实很少。 两个参照记忆方案说明了这种选择为何有效。 仅包含私有事实的记忆在 Qwen 上达到 91.3%，在 Llama 上达到 90.3%，比全部事实的记忆分别高出 +21.5 分 [13.3, 30.3] 和 +28.7 分 [17.9, 39.0]；而仅包含共享事实的记忆只达到 5.6% 和 4.6%，远低于同一运行中的空记忆（35.4% 和 36.4%）。 在 HiddenBench 中，共享事实指向错误的选项，因此去掉它们正是有帮助之处，且没有任何任务含有会误导的稀有事实。 CrossProfile 则加入了此类任务。

paragraphs.en: Averaged over all ownership variants of CrossProfile, R1 is no better than Random: 64.0% against 64.5% on Qwen and 63.0% against 63.4% on Llama (Table 2 ). This average hides a reversal across cells. paragraphs.zh: 在 CrossProfile 的所有所有权变体上取平均，R1 并不优于 Random：在 Qwen 上为 64.0% 对 64.5%，在 Llama 上为 63.0% 对 63.4%（表 2）。 这一平均值掩盖了各单元格之间的反转。 当支撑内容为私有而诱饵为共享时，R1 达到 90% 到 97%，而首次提及选择（B4）降至 11% 到 31%；当支撑内容为共享而诱饵为私有时，顺序反转，B4 为 92% 到 96%，R1 为 18% 到 40%（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: The pre-specified H1 measures this dependence of the R1 advantage over B4 on decoy ownership: + 64.6 +64.6 points [60.3, 69.0] for Qwen and + 62.6 +62.6 [56.8, 68.2] for Llama, both Holm p < .001 p<.001 (Appendix Figure 6 ). Because every shared claim appears in the first turn, B4 keeps shared facts first and is close to a mirror image of R1, so part of H1 is built into the reference. Against Random, the interaction is + 40.7 +40.7 [34.6, 47.1] and + 34.2 +34.2 [27.8, 41.0]; when both policies retain exactly seven facts, H1 is + 66.8 +66.8 [61.9, 71.7] and + 72.6 +72.6 [67.2, 78.1]. The hosted models show the same pattern. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, H1 is + 62.6 +62.6 [56.7, 68.6] and the interaction against Random is + 28.3 +28.3 [22.1, 34.7]; on a 30-template run of DeepSeek-V4-Pro the latter is + 30.6 +30.6 [22.5, 38.6]. On that common subset, R1 minus Random averaged over variants is − 1.7 -1.7 , + 1.7 +1.7 , − 1.3 -1.3 , and − 4.7 -4.7 points on Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
paragraphs.zh: 预先设定的 H1 度量了 R1 相对于 B4 的优势对诱饵所有权的依赖性：Qwen 为 +64.6 分 [60.3, 69.0]，Llama 为 +62.6 [56.8, 68.2]，两者的 Holm p < .001（附录图 6）。 由于每条共享声明都出现在第一轮中，B4 会将共享事实排在前面，因而接近于 R1 的镜像，所以 H1 的一部分已经内建于该参照之中。 相对于 Random，交互效应为 +40.7 [34.6, 47.1] 和 +34.2 [27.8, 41.0]；当两种策略都恰好保留七个事实时，H1 为 +66.8 [61.9, 71.7] 和 +72.6 [67.2, 78.1]。 托管模型呈现出相同的模式。 在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上，H1 为 +62.6 [56.7, 68.6]，相对于 Random 的交互效应为 +28.3 [22.1, 34.7]；在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的 30 模板运行中，后者为 +30.6 [22.5, 38.6]。 在该公共子集上，对各变体取平均后，R1 减去 Random 在 Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上分别为 −1.7、+1.7、−1.3 和 −4.7 分。

paragraphs.en: H3 supports relevance-first priority on average: + 8.5 +8.5 points [3.5, 13.6] for Qwen (Holm p = .002 p=.002 ), + 15.6 +15.6 [11.1, 19.9] for Llama ( p < .001 p<.001 ), and + 16.7 +16.7 [12.8, 20.7] on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and R1-rel has the highest mean among budgeted policies (Table 2 ). We expected no benefit when irrelevant facts are shared, but the gains are + 8.7 +8.7 [4.6, 12.8] and + 7.6 +7.6 [4.2, 11.2]: when all facts are shared, rarity cannot separate irrelevant facts from criterion-related ones, and the relevance tier does.
paragraphs.zh: H3 总体上支持相关性优先：Qwen 提升 + 8.5 +8.5 分 [3.5, 13.6]（Holm p = .002 p=.002），Llama 提升 + 15.6 +15.6 [11.1, 19.9]（p < .001 p<.001），DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 提升 + 16.7 +16.7 [12.8, 20.7]，并且 R1-rel 在有预算的策略中均值最高（表 2 ）。 我们原本预期在共享无关事实时不会有收益，但实际增益为 + 8.7 +8.7 [4.6, 12.8] 和 + 7.6 +7.6 [4.2, 11.2]：当所有事实都被共享时，稀有性无法将无关事实与与准则相关的事实区分开，而相关性分层可以做到这一点。

paragraphs.en: The average combines gains with a large loss. In the classic cell (private support, shared decoys, private irrelevant facts), R1 reaches 96.7% [93.3, 99.4] on Qwen and 97.2% [93.9, 99.4] on Llama, and R1-rel changes accuracy by − 22.2 -22.2 points [ − 28.9 -28.9 , − 16.1 -16.1 ] and − 20.0 -20.0 [ − 26.1 -26.1 , − 13.9 -13.9 ] (Figure 4 ). The relevance tier admits about two shared decoys while retaining slightly less support; because shared decoys carry four holder tags, R1-rel also keeps fewer facts in this cell (8.3 to 8.5 against 9.0 for R1).
paragraphs.zh: 平均值将收益与一大笔损失相结合。 在经典单元格（私有支持信息、共享干扰项、私有无关事实）中，R1 在 Qwen 上达到 96.7% [93.3, 99.4]，在 Llama 上达到 97.2% [93.9, 99.4]，而 R1-rel 使准确率变化 −22.2 [−28.9, −16.1] 和 −20.0 [−26.1, −13.9] 个百分点（图 4）。 相关性层级在保留略少支持信息的同时容纳约两个共享干扰项；由于共享干扰项带有四个持有者标签，R1-rel 在此单元格中也保留了更少的事实（8.3 至 8.5，而 R1 为 9.0）。

paragraphs.en: The failure persists when relevance is known exactly. With evaluator labels that mark both support and decoy facts as relevant, oracle relevance minus R1 is − 23.3 -23.3 [ − 30.6 -30.6 , − 16.1 -16.1 ] for Qwen and − 31.1 -31.1 [ − 38.9 -38.9 , − 23.9 -23.9 ] for Llama in this cell, so filter errors cannot explain the loss. An oracle that marked only support facts would no longer select by relevance; it would select by the answer key. The same holds on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, whose filter is nearly perfect (relevant-class precision 99.4% and recall 98.9%, against recall 66.0% on Qwen and 85.6% on Llama), yet in the same cell R1-rel minus R1 is − 32.2 -32.2 [ − 40.6 -40.6 , − 24.4 -24.4 ] and oracle relevance minus R1 is − 29.4 -29.4 [ − 37.8 -37.8 , − 21.7 -21.7 ]. Relevance separates the decision criteria from other attributes, whereas usefulness depends on the balance of evidence between competing options, which a relevance filter does not see.
paragraphs.zh: 即使相关性完全已知，该失败依然存在。 当评估器标签同时将支持性事实和干扰性事实都标记为相关时，在该单元格中，Qwen 的 oracle 相关性减去 R1 为 − 23.3 [ − 30.6 , − 16.1 ]，Llama 为 − 31.1 [ − 38.9 , − 23.9 ]，因此过滤错误无法解释这一损失。 一个只标记支持性事实的 oracle 将不再按相关性进行选择；它将按答案密钥进行选择。 在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上情况相同，其过滤器近乎完美（相关类别精确率 99.4%，召回率 98.9%，相比之下 Qwen 召回率为 66.0%，Llama 为 85.6%），但在同一单元格中，R1-rel 减去 R1 为 − 32.2 [ − 40.6 , − 24.4 ]，oracle 相关性减去 R1 为 − 29.4 [ − 37.8 , − 21.7 ]。 相关性将决策标准与其他属性区分开来，而有用性则取决于相互竞争的选项之间的证据平衡，这是相关性过滤器所无法看到的。

paragraphs.en: Each memory line begins with the tags of the agents who stated it, and much of this preference follows the tags (Figure 5 ). Without tags, the shared-support advantage of the all-facts memory falls from + 21.0 +21.0 to + 7.2 +7.2 points on Qwen and from + 13.8 +13.8 to + 7.6 +7.6 on Llama. Removing them raises classic-cell accuracy by + 14.4 +14.4 points [7.8, 21.1] on Qwen, + 13.3 +13.3 [6.7, 20.0] on Llama, and + 24.4 +24.4 [17.2, 32.2] on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where it goes from 72.8% to 97.2%. The tags, not the line order, carry this effect: both conditions keep the transcript-derived order, and reassigning the same tag sets to facts at random, again with order fixed, also raises classic-cell accuracy, by + 12.8 +12.8 points on both open models. The effect is not simply an error. Where support is shared and decoys are private, removing the tags lowers Qwen’s accuracy by − 10.6 -10.6 points [ − 16.7 -16.7 , − 4.4 -4.4 ]: the model treats a fact stated by many agents as more credible, which helps when the widely held facts are the useful ones and misleads when they are not. In CrossProfile the shared facts were assigned to every agent rather than observed independently, so the tags carry no extra evidence. On a common 30-template subset the tagged gap is + 17.8 +17.8 on Qwen, + 12.5 +12.5 on Llama, + 6.1 +6.1 on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and + 7.2 +7.2 on DeepSeek-V4-Pro. This attribution effect is an analogue of the common-knowledge effect that arises after the discussion rather than during it, and it accounts for part of R1’s advantage in the classic cell: R1 drops the shared facts that the decision model overweights.

paragraphs.en: Neither rarity nor relevance is a safe default for the memory of an LLM group. In CrossProfile, rarity helps only in the ownership cells where rare facts support the answer, relevance readmits on-topic decoys even with a perfect filter, and the decision model follows social proof, giving extra weight to facts that many agents are tagged as stating. What drives the decision is the balance of evidence between options that the memory leaves, and how the reader weighs its attribution. Memory designs for agent groups should therefore aim at that balance rather than at prevalence or topic, and should not present how many agents stated a fact as evidence for it when the sources are not independent. Evaluations should vary who holds which evidence, and should check whether that evidence reached the discussion at all.
paragraphs.zh: 对于大语言模型群体的记忆而言，稀有性和相关性都不是安全的默认选择。 在 CrossProfile 中，稀有性只在那些稀有事实能够支持答案的归属单元格中发挥作用，相关性会让切题的诱饵信息即便在有完美过滤器的情况下也被重新纳入，而决策模型则跟随社会认同，对被许多智能体标记为陈述过的事实赋予额外权重。 真正驱动决策的是记忆所留下的各选项之间证据的平衡，以及读者如何权衡证据的归属。 因此，面向智能体群体的记忆设计应当瞄准这种平衡，而不是流行度或主题，并且在信息来源并非相互独立时，不应把有多少智能体陈述过某个事实作为支持该事实的证据。 评估应当变换谁持有哪份证据，并且应当核查这些证据是否真的到达了讨论之中。

sents.en: Neither rarity nor relevance is a safe default for the memory of an LLM group.
sents.zh: 对于大语言模型群体的记忆而言，稀有性和相关性都不是安全的默认选择。

sents.en: In CrossProfile, rarity helps only in the ownership cells where rare facts support the answer, relevance readmits on-topic decoys even with a perfect filter, and the decision model follows social proof, giving extra weight to facts that many agents are tagged as stating.
sents.zh: 在 CrossProfile 中，稀有性只在那些稀有事实能够支持答案的归属单元格中发挥作用，相关性会让切题的诱饵信息即便在有完美过滤器的情况下也被重新纳入，而决策模型则跟随社会认同，对被许多智能体标记为陈述过的事实赋予额外权重。

sents.en: What drives the decision is the balance of evidence between options that the memory leaves, and how the reader weighs its attribution.
sents.zh: 真正驱动决策的是记忆所留下的各选项之间证据的平衡，以及读者如何权衡证据的归属。

sents.en: Memory designs for agent groups should therefore aim at that balance rather than at prevalence or topic, and should not present how many agents stated a fact as evidence for it when the sources are not independent.
sents.zh: 因此，面向智能体群体的记忆设计应当瞄准这种平衡，而不是流行度或主题，并且在信息来源并非相互独立时，不应把有多少智能体陈述过某个事实作为支持该事实的证据。

sents.en: Evaluations should vary who holds which evidence, and should check whether that evidence reached the discussion at all.
sents.zh: 评估应当变换谁持有哪份证据，并且应当核查这些证据是否真的到达了讨论之中。

paragraphs.en: CrossProfile has ten pilot and 60 main templates. The 60 main templates cover 12 decision domains with five templates each: hospital equipment purchase (M01–M05), school lunch vendor (M06–M10), city bus route (M11–M15), warehouse location (M16–M20), software hosting vendor (M21–M25), community clinic site (M26–M30), job candidate for a lab (M31–M35), conference venue (M36–M40), bridge repair contractor (M41–M45), farm irrigation system (M46–M50), library renovation (M51–M55), and emergency shelter site (M56–M60). Each main template has four agents, three options, and 12 facts. The support group contains three facts in favor of the correct option and two against the decoy option; the decoy group contains two facts in favor of the decoy and one against the correct option. The four irrelevant facts have two positive and two negative tones. The role structure is specified before the sentences are written, and facts receive neutral IDs in random order. Relevance refers to the stated criteria, not to whether a fact favors the answer.
